concepts.gloss_en: The joy of the festival (Yom Tov)

members.note: representative; the bare construct naming the concept

concepts.gloss_en: The essence/root of festival joy — a different construct head (עקר) governing 'joy of Yom Tov', not the joy itself

members.note: different construct head עקר; 'the essence of X' ≠ X per rule 4

concepts.gloss_en: A predication that a person 'has' festival joy (a clause/state), distinct from the abstract concept of festival joy

members.note: predicative clause (having the joy), not the concept-noun itself; under-merge per rule 1/4

notes: All three occur in the same passage (lm2:4). Kept separate: bare concept, essence-of construct (different head), and predicative 'he has' clause. Under-merge preferred; a human may choose to fold 'יש לו שמחת יום טוב' into the bare concept if surface-clause nodes are normalized elsewhere.
